svg.title: Observability layer across the system
svg.desc: Diagram showing every component, gateway, services, cache, database, and message queue, each emitting logs, metrics, and traces to a central observability stack feeding dashboards and alerts
svg.text: logs, metrics, traces from every component

g.text: Collector — one trace ID follows a request across every hop

svg.text: Without this layer, a slow response gives no clue which hop caused it
